name: Clari
tagline: Clari is an AI-powered revenue operations platform that analyses CRM data, activity signals, and conversation intelligence to provide accurate sales forecasts. Its AI identifies at-risk deals, prioritises accounts, and automates pipeline inspection. Enterprise sales organisations use it to reduce forecasting variance and increase win rates.
